newsitem.title: USA: McDonald's says on yr-to-date results on track.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's says on yr-to-date results on track.

text.p: McDonald's Corp, which continues to face intense competition in the U.S. fast-food market, said Wednesday its year-to-date results are on track, although May and June were below targets.

"May and June results were below our expectations," Jack Greenberg, chairman of the McDonald's USA unit, told reporters on a teleconference. This followed strong results for the first quarter and in the month of April, he added.
"Year-to-date, while we really didn't expect the ups and downs that we've had, we are just about where we expected to be a in year of transition," Greenberg said.
